# MVAHCS Protocol for Antibiotic Loaded Bone Cement (ALBC) for

# Treatment of Periprosthetic Hip and Knee Joint Infections

# Patient Classification:

No beta-lactam allergy: gram-positive and/or non-pseudomonas

gram-negative infection

[Cefuroxime and vancomycin ALBC order set](orz-set-abx-vanco-cefuroxime-albc-spacer-ortho)

# Patient Classification:

Beta-lactam allergy, any infecting organism OR No beta-lactam allergy,

but with documented pseudomonas infection

[Aztreonam and vancomycin ALBC order set](orz-set-abx-vanco-aztreonam-albc-spacer-ortho)

# References

MVAHCS Protocol for Use of Antibiotic Loaded Cement (ALBC) for Treatment of

Periprosthetic Hip and Knee Joint Infections at The Minneapolis VA

Medical Center, July 2017
